name: editorial-illustration-generator
title_zh: 把照片转成复古编辑部插画，保留构图与主体关系
tagline_zh: 不是滤镜，是排版级插画。日式档案印刷、世纪中叶图形、Riso 孔版、标本页——上传食物、建筑、人像。
tagline_en: Not a filter—editorial-grade illustration. Japanese archive print, mid-century graphics, risograph, specimen.
desc_en: Transform any user-uploaded photo into a vintage editorial print illustration—not a photo filter. Use for food, beverage, landscape, architecture, portrait, or product images that need Japanese archive print, mid-century graphic, risograph, specimen-sheet, or handmade editorial-art direction while preserving source aspect ratio, composition, and subject relationships.
why_zh: 它先解析照片的构图与主体关系，再按风格库重绘，而非像素级套色。五种复古印刷方向各自有独立的纹理与色域映。
why_en: It parses composition and subject hierarchy first, then redraws per style library—not pixel recoloring. Five print aesthetics.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，不吃多图拼贴或透明背景 PNG；输出是静态位图，不生成矢量或分层文件；风格限定五种复古印刷方向。
limit_en: Single photos only—no collages or transparent PNGs. Output is static raster, no vectors or layers. Five print styles only; outside that it stops.
